name: mirage
text: On it: same-game 2-leg parlays (side/moneyline + game total) now. I checked how correlated they really are on 18,000 college games: within about 2.4% of independent, and the market charges 13% over independent on these, so a premium keeps us on the right side. Building it with a 6% premium on the joint probability on top of the normal margin.
